text:
incbot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — customer 'cust-omega' reports partial connectivity loss to their PrivateConnect endpoint in us-west2. Error rate spike and TCP resets observed. Paging raj_oncall.

raj_oncall: Got the page, looking. Any customer impact details?

maria_net: Monitoring shows ~30% of flows from cust-omega -> our privatelink endpoint (10.200.5.0/24) are returning RST/ICMP unreachable. Other flows are fine.

lee_sre: I can confirm HTTP 504/connection timeouts from our edge -> privatelink VIP in us-west2 across some AZs. Happening since ~T-6m.

raj_oncall: @maria_net can you paste BGP/route views and any recent config changes? Also check DNS for that privatelink hostname — TTL changes sometimes cause odd client caching.

maria_net: Nothing changed in our BGP configs in last 24h. Getting BGP adjacencies now. Partial AS path alternation observed on one of the transit routers (rt-usw2-03).

maria_net: Traceroute from edge-prod-02 -> 10.200.5.12 (privatelink VIP):
```
traceroute to 10.200.5.12 (10.200.5.12), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.10.1.1  0.62 ms  0.60 ms  0.58 ms
 2  203.0.113.5  2.01 ms  2.02 ms  2.04 ms
 3  198.51.100.10  *  4.91 ms  5.02 ms
 4  * * *
```

lee_sre: Looks like path blackhole after hop 3 from some edges. Could be ECMP asymmetry with next-hop flaps.

sylvia_support: Customer reports their healthchecks failing intermittently and app errors for some users — they are seeing 503s for a subset of traffic. This is definitely customer-impacting.

raj_oncall: Ok escalate to network. @maria_net check BGP RIB differences between rt-usw2-02 and rt-usw2-03 for prefix 10.200.5.0/24 and any MED/LocalPref anomalies. Also check NX-OS logs for flap events.

maria_net: RIB dump snippet (filtered):
```
rt-usw2-02> show ip bgp 10.200.5.0/24
 10.200.5.0/24 via 192.0.2.1 (local) metric 0, path 65010 65020
rt-usw2-03> show ip bgp 10.200.5.0/24
 10.200.5.0/24 via 203.0.113.9 metric 0, path 65010 65099 65020 (localpref 100)
```

maria_net: Notice rt-usw2-03 is preferring a longer AS path via an external partner (65099) due to a missing community that normally prefers the direct path. That partner is flapping a link.

lee_sre: That explains path asymmetry. Are we leaking a route with different next-hops causing some edges to hit the flaky transit?

maria_net: Yes. Quick mitigation: prepend a blackhole route via our internal next-hop on rt-usw2-03 for the affected prefix to steer traffic away from the partner, while we fix upstream.

raj_oncall: Do it. Also update customer-facing status re: mitigation in progress. @sylvia_support prepare a one-liner explaining partial impact and mitigation.

maria_net: Applying route-map to override path on rt-usw2-03 now.
```
conf t
route-map OVERRIDE permit 10
 set ip next-hop 192.0.2.1
exit
```

deploybot: :white_check_mark: route-map OVERRIDE applied to rt-usw2-03 — changes diff propagated to iBGP and edge routers.

lee_sre: Start sampling traffic from cust-omega post-change.

raj_oncall: Also check DNS TTL. If customer's apps cached the privatelink hostname to a now-unreachable AZ VIP, DNS low TTL helps, but if TTL was high they could be stuck. What does our DNS authoritatve show?

maria_net: DNS check for privatelink host priv-omega.usw2.redwood.net:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> priv-omega.usw2.redwood.net A
;; ANSWER SECTION:
priv-omega.usw2.redwood.net. 300 IN A 10.200.5.12
```

maria_net: TTL is 300s. Customer said they used a caching resolver with long caching — may still have old negative cache entries. We saw some NXDOMAIN/REFUSED responses during the flap; their resolver may have cached that.

sylvia_support: Posted to customer: "We're seeing partial egress loss from our us-west2 private connectivity. Engineering has applied a steering rule to avoid a flaky partner; you may see some recovery in minutes. We are monitoring and will follow up."

tom_cs: Customer acknowledged and appreciates the update. Asking for ETA to full recovery.

maria_net: After change, edge traceroutes show consistent path via 192.0.2.1; packet loss drops to baseline.

lee_sre: Monitoring shows error rate for cust-omega dropped from 28% -> 4% over 3 minutes. Still some clients behind stubborn resolvers hitting stale DNS negative cache — expected to clear within TTL windows or after resolver restart.

raj_oncall: Good. Let's keep mitigation for 30 min and watch. Then we can remove the override and push a permanent community to prefer internal path. Also log incident for follow-up: missing community propagated to partner causing preference change.

maria_net: I'll open a post-incident CR: add explicit community policy to ensure partner does not become preferred path and alert on unexpected AS-path length changes.

lee_sre: Any need for on-call handoff? I'm available for at least the next hour.

raj_oncall: I'll stay on it until we confirm stable for 30 minutes, then hand to next oncall for watch. @sylvia_support please keep customer updated that final resolution expected within TTL window (~5min) and full clean-up later.

sylvia_support: Will do.

incbot: :information_source: Incident P1 created: 3845000123 — "cust-omega PrivateConnect partial egress loss (us-west2)". Status: mitigated (steering rule applied). Owner: maria_net.

raj_oncall: Closing page for now but keeping the thread live for follow-ups. Good work everyone.

sylvia_support: Customer reports traffic restored for most users. They will monitor and re-open if they see regressions.

maria_net: Will submit RCA doc with timeline and config diffs.

lee_sre: Note for RCA: include traceroutes, BGP RIB snapshots, partner logs if we can get them, and DNS anomaly notes.

tom_cs: Thanks team. I'll sync this into the customer ticket.

raj_oncall: End of thread.
